Signals are recorded when they open and evaluated when they close. Nothing has closed under the corrected bookkeeping yet, so there is nothing here to total — that is the honest state, not an error.

Results are percentage points, summed, with every closed signal counted once at equal weight and no compounding. That weights a 2% move on a $20 stock the same as on a $500 one, and the scanner often holds twenty-odd positions at once — so this is a scorecard for the signals, not a statement for an account anyone could have run. SPY is summed the same way over the same holding windows.

Trading Signals API

Use these endpoints to integrate Super Picks with automated trading systems. Base URL: https://superpickstrading.com

GET /api/signals
Trading signals optimized for bot consumption. Returns action (STRONG_BUY, BUY, HOLD), confidence score, and current price.
{ "timestamp": "2025-01-15T15:30:00.000Z", "market_open": true, "count": 5, "signals": [ { "symbol": "NVDA", "action": "STRONG_BUY", "signal": "Strong Buy", "score": 7.8, "price": 148.50, "change_pct": 2.3, "confidence": 0.89, "updated": "2025-01-15T15:25:00" } ] }
GET /api/picks
Full technical pick details with all indicator breakdowns (momentum, MACD, SMA, stochastic, volume, CCI, Williams %R).
{ "picks": [ { "symbol": "NVDA", "name": "NVIDIA Corp", "composite_score": 7.8, "overall_signal": "Strong Buy", "price": 148.50, "daily_change": 2.3, "momentum_score": 0.9, "momentum_label": "Bullish", "macd_score": 0.8, "macd_label": "Bullish Crossover", "sma_score": 1.0, "sma_label": "Above SMA", "stoch_score": 0.6, "stoch_label": "Bullish", "volume_score": 0.7, "volume_label": "High Volume", "cci_score": 0.5, "cci_label": "Bullish", "willr_score": 0.3, "willr_label": "Neutral", "updated_at": "2025-01-15T15:25:00" } ] }
GET /api/alpha
Smart money alpha signals from unusual activity detection. Includes conviction scores, tier rankings, and source breakdown (dark pool, insider, options flow).
{ "picks": [ { "symbol": "AAPL", "name": "Apple Inc", "price": 234.50, "dailyChange": 1.8, "conviction": 87, "tier": "S", "sources": ["darkpool", "options"], "updatedAt": "2025-01-15T15:30:00" } ] }
GET /api/fundamentals
Fundamental analysis scores with financial metrics. Each stock receives a 1-10 score based on valuation, profitability, growth, and financial health.
{ "stocks": [ { "symbol": "MSFT", "name": "Microsoft Corp", "sector": "Technology", "price": 425.00, "return1Y": 28.5, "dividendYield": 0.72, "pe": 35.2, "profitMargin": 36.4, "returnOnEquity": 38.5, "debtToEquity": 0.42, "fundamentalScore": 8.5, "overallLabel": "Strong Buy", "signals": { ... } } ] }
GET /api/sentiment
Market sentiment score with index performance, sector breakdown, and breadth data. Score 0-100 (Fear to Greed).
{ "score": 62, "label": "Greed", "zone": "greed", "indices": [ { "symbol": "SPY", "name": "S&P 500", "price": 595.20, "change": 0.85 } ], "sectors": [ { "symbol": "XLK", "name": "Technology", "change": 1.2 } ], "breadth": { ... } }
GET /api/sectors?class=equity&period=1M
Sector rotation, the same scan the app's Sector Map runs. class is equity (vs SPY, refreshed 10:00 AM / 1:00 PM / 4:00 PM ET) or crypto (vs BTC, every two hours). period is any of 1D, 3D, 1W, 2W, 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y or SINCE (change since the last checkpoint). The views carry tickers; look them up in rows.
{ "assetClass": "equity", "asof": "2026-08-28", "nextCheckpoint": { "label": "Mon 10:00 AM ET" }, "sectors": [ { "name": "TECH", "median": 13.6, "count": 52, "leaders": 14, "broken": 11, "subsectors": [ { "name": "Software", "median": 25.8, "members": ["TEAM", "ESTC", "MDB"] } ] } ], "etfs": [ { "symbol": "XLK", "ret": 8.5, "vsSpy": 4.7 } ], "flow": [ { "sector": "UTILITIES", "longRank": 11, "shortRank": 4, "rankDelta": 7 } ], "read": [ { "text": "Money is rotating into UTILITIES..." } ], "rows": [ { "ticker": "TEAM", "1M": 90.5, "trendScore": 95, "rsi14": 79, "setup": "NEUTRAL", "signals": ["NEW_HIGH", "ACCELERATING"] } ] }
GET /api/stats
Overall performance statistics -- win rate, average return, best/worst trades, and recent scan logs.
GET /api/history?status=closed&limit=50
Historical trades with entry/exit prices and returns. Filter by status: active, closed, or all.
POST /api/picks
Push picks from the scanner. Requires X-API-Key header.
// Header: X-API-Key: your-secret-key { "picks": [ { "symbol": "NVDA", "name": "NVIDIA Corp", "compositeScore": 7.8, "overallSignal": "Strong Buy", "price": 148.50, "dailyChange": 2.3, "indicators": { "momentum": { "score": 0.9, "label": "Bullish" }, "macd": { "score": 0.8, "label": "Bullish Crossover" }, "sma": { "score": 1.0, "label": "Above SMA" }, "stochastic": { "score": 0.6, "label": "Bullish" }, "volume": { "score": 0.7, "label": "High Volume" }, "cci": { "score": 0.5, "label": "Bullish" }, "williamsR": { "score": 0.3, "label": "Neutral" } } } ], "scanMeta": { "totalScanned": 130, "scanTimeMs": 45000 } }
Robinhood Integration Example
Python example for automated trading using the signals endpoint:
import requests import robin_stocks.robinhood as rh # Fetch Super Picks signals signals = requests.get("https://superpickstrading.com/api/signals").json() # Login to Robinhood (use your own auth) rh.login(username="your_email", password="your_password") for signal in signals["signals"]: if signal["action"] == "STRONG_BUY" and signal["confidence"] > 0.8: # Place a market order rh.orders.order_buy_market( symbol=signal["symbol"], quantity=1, timeInForce="gfd" ) print(f"Bought {signal['symbol']} at ${signal['price']}") rh.logout()
